evidence.observation: Pressure stable at ~3.00 Torr through ramp and early growth
Pressure rose steadily from 3.003 to 3.227 Torr over 480 s of growth
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the rise is not caused by more gas going in
Thermocouple steady at ~749.8 °C, heater power steady at ~44%; temperature control normal
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed, so air ingress can't be confirmed or ruled out

args.missing_evidence: Can't yet tell an exhaust blockage from a seal leak. An exhaust O2 reading would settle it; failing that, change the Ar flow briefly or close the inlet to check the leak-up rate, and inspect the exhaust line/pump.
